Muslims Day July 2026 Release Summary

In July 2026 we have released two major features and few improvements.

New Features

  1. Ruqyah text & Audio feature added

  2. Istigfar reminder feature added

Improvements

  1. Improved Amal Tracker with a new History view

  2. UI Improvements

  3. Various bug fixes and stability improvements
